title: Locker Room, Coatroom, and Dressing Room Attendants
description: Provide personal items to patrons or customers in locker rooms, dressing rooms, or coatrooms.

projection.title: Locker room, coatroom, and dressing room attendants

tasks.text: Clean facilities such as floors or locker rooms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and work areas

tasks.text: Provide towels and sheets to clients in public baths, steam rooms, and restrooms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on distribution of resources to people

dwas.name: Distribute resources to patrons or employees.

tasks.text: Collect soiled linen or clothing for laundering.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Housekeeping is physical labor in varied spaces

tasks.text: Refer guest problems or complaints to supervisors.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Complaint resolution needs authority and rapport

dwas.name: Resolve customer complaints or problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Maintain a lost-and-found collection.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically placing and storing items

tasks.text: Clean and polish footwear, using brushes, sponges, cleaning fluid, polishes, waxes, liquid or sole dressing, and daubers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual cleaning of fabrics with unpredictable materials

tasks.text: Check supplies to ensure adequate availability, and order new supplies when necessary.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Digital tracking automatable; physical stock checks need humans

dwas.name: Monitor availability of equipment or supplies.

tasks.text: Report and document safety hazards, potentially hazardous conditions, and unsafe practices and procedures.

dwas.name: Monitor patron activities to identify problems or potential problems.

tasks.text: Assign dressing room facilities, locker space, or clothing containers to patrons of athletic or bathing establishments.

dwas.name: Assign resources or facilities to patrons or employees.

tasks.text: Issue gym clothes, uniforms, towels, athletic equipment, and special athletic apparel.

dwas.name: Assign resources or facilities to patrons or employees.

tasks.text: Answer customer inquiries or explain cost, availability, policies, and procedures of facilities.

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

dwas.name: Respond to customer inquiries.
